status: additive same-run parent-field versus post-map measurement; exploratory, no quality threshold

new_measurement.preMap: write C, V, U, p, face centers/areas/owners/neighbours/phi/Uf immediately before mesh_.update() at t=0.002
new_measurement.mapped: same fields immediately after mesh_.update() at t=0.002

acceptance.measurement_gate: Exactly six named stage events; preMap has 4096 cells, mapped has the refined topology, both at t=0.002; solver exits zero with End; LD_DEBUG confirms instrumented library load.
analysis: Compare mapped cell values against piecewise-constant injection from this run's preMap field using geometrically containing uniform-grid parents.
Check parent-child volume closure, cell counts, levels, domain integral and weighted relative L2/max absolute differences.
Decompose point-sample error algebraically into inherited parent-center error, exact-reference center shift, and cross term; do not label this finite-volume truncation error.
Compare mapped and exact-MMS cell-center samples only as point-sample diagnostics; keep finite-volume cell-average accuracy claims separate.
Compare preMap and mapped face flux/divergence only after matching geometric face relationships; no assumption that face indices persist across remapping.
acceptance.quality_gate: None. The run is a mapping-mechanism diagnostic, not a convergence or solver-quality pass/fail.

limits: The preMap and mapped pair is same-run, but equality with piecewise-constant injection would establish transfer behavior only for this case and field representation.
A single n=16 event is not a resolution study or a general AMR guarantee.
The packaged solver stack is not proven source-equivalent; only the instrumented incompressibleFluid module is compiled from the pinned source commit and library load is recorded.
The trigger time is chosen from the frozen v3 event and is exploratory rather than preregistered before any earlier observation.
